headline: VisionQuest Reveals True Origins of Stark AIs
post:
Get ready, Marvel fans! VisionQuest is finally giving us the real backstory behind some of Tony Stark's famous AIs. It turns out E.D.I.T.H. and F.R.I.D.A.Y. are modeled after real people from Howard Stark and Tony's lives, including a Stark test pilot and Happy Hogan's mother!

It is fascinating to see how these characters connect to the bigger MCU history. What do you think about these AI having human origins?

headline: Clint Eastwood Western poster beats Star Wars
post:
An original Italian poster for Clint Eastwood's classic The Good, the Bad and the Ugly recently brought in a massive $31,500 hammer price at a PropStore auction.

That impressive sale actually managed to outsell a cast-signed original Star Wars poster by $3,000 in the same auction event! 🤠

Would you rather own a prized piece of Western cinema history or a classic space saga collectible?

#ClintEastwood #StarWars #Westerns
original_title: Clint Eastwood’s Greatest Western Just Beat Star Wars in the Most Unexpected Way

headline: Uncanny X-Men introduces the Scavenged team
post:
According to Screen Rant, Marvel's Uncanny X-Men has officially debuted a dangerous new unit of brainwashed mutant villains called the Scavenged. These characters were created through project 'X-Finity' at Graymalkin Prison, which aimed to build an army of "New Wolverines" to target anti-superhuman goals.

The team includes intriguing members like Fawn, Polyphemus, Curare, and Pilot, all sporting retractable metal claws and enhanced abilities. Led by Sarah Gaunt, also known as the Hag, this terrifying group has been unleashed directly against Monet's X-Men in recent issues.

Which of the New Mutants do you think will be targeted next? 🧬

#UncannyXMen #MarvelComics #XMen
original_title: X-Men Just Officially Announced Historic New Team, All Members And Powers

headline: Poison Ivy TV Series in Development
post:

While the project is still in its early stages and casting details are not available yet, sources indicate this villain-focused show would not be part of Matt Reeves’ movie universe.

headline: Louise Simonson leads DC Year of Wonder
post:
Get ready for a massive era for the Amazon Princess! According to ComicBook.com, DC announced a full year devoted to unforgettable stories for our favorite hero starting in 2027. 

Kicking things off on January 20th, legendary writer Louise Simonson will take on the main title with artist Cian Tormey for a four-issue story. Simonson stated it is a "dream come true" to write Diana and team her up with Lois Lane, while also throwing Granny Goodness and her Female Furies into the mix for some fun! Simonson's run will set up a bold new status quo, paving the way for her sisters to return to Man’s World.

After that, Stephanie Williams and artist Elena Casagrande will take over for a six-issue arc that runs through October 2027, which includes a Nubia team-up. More creators and stories are still to be revealed for this epic celebration! 

Are you excited for the upcoming creative teams? 🌟

#WonderWoman #DCComics #YearOfWonder
original_title: DC’s Year of Wonder Will Bring Legendary Writer Louise Simonson to Wonder Woman (And That’s Just the Start)
